FX-TURB-001.says: The settings as they start: amount 10, size 60, complexity 2, evolution 0, speed 20, seed 0, edges transparent. A wave is wider than the drawing, so each pixel reads from two to four pixels left of it and two to five below, not quite alike everywhere: the drawing is carried right and up and its stripes lean and bend gently; the warp moves a little from frame 0 to 2 to 4. The first three columns read from past the drawing's left edge and are empty on every frame.

FX-TURB-002.says: Amount 0: the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-TURB-003.says: Amount 3, size 8: a wave every eight pixels, so the stripes bend into waves and the blue band wobbles; frame 4 is warped differently from frame 0.

FX-TURB-004.says: Amount 3, size 8, speed 0: the warp holds still, the same on frames 0, 2 and 4, and is FX-TURB-003's frame 0.

FX-TURB-005.says: FX-TURB-004 with edges repeat: the layer does not grow, and a push past the drawing's edge reads the nearest edge pixel, so where FX-TURB-004 reads emptiness at the left edge this reads the stripe there.

FX-TURB-006.says: Complexity 1, amount 3, size 8, speed 0: one octave, a smoother warp than FX-TURB-004's two.

FX-TURB-007.says: Complexity 8, amount 3, size 8, speed 0: eight octaves, a rougher warp.

FX-TURB-008.says: Size 1, amount 3, speed 0: a wave every pixel, so the drawing breaks up into a jumble.

FX-TURB-009.says: Size 1000, amount 3, speed 0: the wave is so wide that every pixel is pushed alike, within a hundredth of a pixel: the drawing slides whole.

FX-TURB-010.says: Amount 3, size 8, speed 90: frame 0 is FX-TURB-004; frame 2 is evolution 180, and frame 4 is evolution 360, FX-TURB-011.

FX-TURB-011.says: Amount 3, size 8, evolution 360, speed 0: one full turn moves the field one cell through its third direction, a warp of its own.

FX-TURB-012.says: Amount 3, size 8, speed 0, seed 8: a warp of its own.

FX-TURB-015.says: Size 8, speed 0, amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is amount 2, and frame 4 amount 4.

FX-TURB-016.says: Amount 3, size 8, speed keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4, eased past its end (477 at frame 2): frame 0 is FX-TURB-004, and frame 2 is held at 360, so it is speed 360's frame 2.

FX-TURB-017.says: FX-TURB-012 moved three pixels right: the warp is worked in the drawing's own space, so it moves with it, and the three columns left of the drawing show the grown pixels, into which the stripes are pushed.

FX-TURB-018.says: FX-TURB-005, edges repeat, moved three pixels right: nothing grows, so the three columns left of the drawing stay empty.

FX-TURB-019.says: Amount 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-020.says: Size 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-021.says: Complexity 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-022.says: Speed -361, below -360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-023.says: Seed 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-024.says: Amount keyed to 1500 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-025.says: Edges "wrap", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURB-026.says: Edges "Repeat": the word is exact, so a capital is not the choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
